BreadPerLight.definition: Number of slices of bread required to make one light grilled cheese sandwich

CheesePerLight.definition: Number of slices of cheese required to make one light grilled cheese sandwich

BreadPerHeavy.definition: Number of slices of bread required to make one heavy grilled cheese sandwich

CheesePerHeavy.definition: Number of slices of cheese required to make one heavy grilled cheese sandwich

MinHeavyToLightRatio.definition: Minimum ratio of heavy grilled cheese sandwiches to light grilled cheese sandwiches

TotalBread.definition: Total number of slices of bread available

TotalCheese.definition: Total number of slices of cheese available

TimePerLight.definition: Time in minutes to make one light grilled cheese sandwich

TimePerHeavy.definition: Time in minutes to make one heavy grilled cheese sandwich
